theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_rc_limsup_lintegral_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → limsup (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂(μs j)) atTop ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
